::: {.home-bio}
I'm Cody. I measure, model, and otherwise muck about with data. Occupationally nomadic, I've been an academic advisor, a grad student in English, and a software engineer on an energy trading desk.

Outside the world of data, I enjoy singing sea shanties, reading fantasy fiction, and designing escape-room-style puzzle games.
